name: Click Between Frames (GD 2.113)
description: Allows inputs to register between frames. Port for GD 2.113 / Geode v1.3.10.

soft-toggle.name: Disable CBF
soft-toggle.description: Disable CBF without needing to restart GD.

click-between-steps.name: Click Between Steps
click-between-steps.description: Apply each input at the start of the physics step it happened in (like 2.2's Click Between Steps) instead of the exact moment. The step rate is set below.

steps-tps.name: Steps per second (TPS)
steps-tps.description: Step rate used by Click Between Steps. 360 is the highest GD 2.1 accepts. If your FPS is higher than this, inputs go at the start of the frame.
